photos.title: Garden City Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: the beach, rows of beach houses, and the marsh and tidal creeks behind them, with docks on the far shore.
photos.caption: Beach houses along Waccamaw Drive, seen from over the ocean, with the salt marsh and its creeks behind them and docks on the far shore.
photos.alt: Beach houses in rows between the ocean beach and a wide marsh with tidal creeks and boat docks at Garden City Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24 at 500 ft, about 1,200 ft offshore, Nikon D1X, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_175537d.jpg from 11CCH03_0824_175500.zip; aircraft position 33.568493 N, 78.997795 W (the position of the plane, not of the houses). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX.
